Hey, I'm Nicholas Baulch. I enjoy economics, data, programming, AI tools, and more. This is my personal site where I can explore ideas on my own time.

I use AI tools to help collect data, but all analysis and writing is my own.

### A bit about me

I work as an economist at U.S. Bank, leading the scenario design team. Prior to that, I spent four years working as an international economist at the U.S. Department of Treasury, where I had the priveledge to work on a range of issues from covering Ukraine's economy following Russia's invasion to helping coordinate Treasury's support to Fed lending facilities during COVID.

I live with my wife and two kids in the Charlotte area. When not playing with (or wrangling) my twin kids, I like to run, bike, read fantasy, and play board games.
